events.sy: ...Scotland v North Macedonia. Live coverage from Hampden as Scotland host North Macedonia in the Nations League. [S] [HD]

events.t: Match of the Day Wales: Norway v Wales
events.sy: Live coverage as Wales take on Norway in Oslo for their penultimate game in the Nations League. [S] [HD]
...Northern Ireland v Ukraine. Live coverage as Northern Ireland host Ukraine in the Nations League with promotion to League A in sight. [S] [HD]
Live coverage of Scotland's Nations League trip to Switzerland. [S] [HD]

events.t: Match of the Day Wales: Wales v Portugal
events.sy: Live international football as Wales welcome Portugal to the Cardiff City Stadium in their final match of the Nations League. [S] [HD]

events.t: International Football: Hungary v Northern Ireland
events.sy: Northern Ireland's UEFA Nations League campaign reaches its conclusion at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest as they take on Hungary. [S] [HD]

events.t: France v South Africa: Nations Championship
events.sy: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as France face reigning world champions South Africa at the Stade de France in Paris.
Round Five of the Nations Championship as Italy host Argentina at the Stadio Luigi Ferraris in Genoa. Lauren Salter presents with Jamie Roberts and Sam Warburton.

events.t: Wales v New Zealand: Nations Championship
events.sy: Live Rugby from Round Five of the Nations Championship as Wales host New Zealand in Cardiff. Lauren Salter presents with Sean Fitzpatrick, Sam Warburton and Dan Biggar.
Mark Pougatch is joined by Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi for live coverage of England against Japan in the Nations Championship.
Mark Pougatch is joined by Ugo Monye and Maggie Alphonsi for live coverage of Ireland against Fiji in the Nations Championship.
Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the Nations Championship as Scotland face next year's Rugby World Cup hosts, Australia at Murrayfield.

events.t: Spain v England: UEFA Nations League
events.sy: England take on Spain in the last group game of the Nations League, where they will want to make up for their 3-2 loss to the World Champions at Wembley in September.

events.t: New: The Debrief with Dan and ROG
events.sy: Claire Thomas is joined by Dan Biggar and Ronan O'Gara to pick over all the talking points from a busy weekend of Nations Championship action. S1 Ep5
